description: This Java source file defines the ModelNotification class, which manages notification configurations and sending notifications within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for building notification contexts, retrieving notification details, and triggering notification services based on events.

classes.name: ModelNotification
classes.description: Represents a notification model that manages notification groups, builds notification contexts, and triggers notification services based on events.

methods.name: getNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the notification group.

methods.name: setNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Sets the name of the notification group.

methods.name: callNotify
methods.description: Triggers the notification service if the event matches the notification event.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Builds the context map for the notification, including email addresses, subject, and other parameters.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedAddressList
methods.description: Retrieves a comma-separated list of email addresses for a given notification type.

methods.name: getAddressesByType
methods.description: Gets a list of addresses from a NotificationGroup for a specific type.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject line for the notification.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the screen URI for the notification.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service name to trigger for the notification.

methods.name: getNotificationGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a NotificationGroup object by name from the service configuration.
